errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps scores for GPT-4o and Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct in chart (a). Color mapping visual confirms GPT-4o with purple has 74.6% and Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct with green has 71.4%.
The legend indicates TTS refers to GPT-4o, which is purple in chart (a), not pink like o1-mini which has 90.0% in chart (b).
In chart (c), the grey bar (o1-preview) is at 94.8%, not o1.
Description does not mention the comparison intent of smaller LLMs surpassing larger LLMs, as is evident in the title and reference.
Missing mention of percentage units in the vertical axis description.
